launches.name: Waydev Agent

Ask Waydev, our agent, turns engineering data into answers in plain English (and more). Skills let you configure it with SKILL.md files. MCP exposes your engineering feed to any external agent. Built for engineering leaders who'd rather have conversations than dashboards.

It also helps debug, update, and maintain automations as websites change.

Frontline teams move workers from application to day-1 faster while reducing manual follow-up, onboarding delays, and audit risk across healthcare, logistics, staffing, retail, and field operations.

launches.name: Hestus

Hestus lives natively in your CAD environment, predicting your next move by understanding design intent in real-time. Just design as you always do, only much faster.

launches.name: Nucleo
launches.tagline: Automated cancer diagnostics

launches.name: Blaze

launches.description: Blaze is your complete productivity system. Tasks, events, projects, and notes: all in one smart calendar. Connect Google Calendar and Apple Calendar, collaborate with your team, and let the AI reorganize your day, find free slots, and balance your workload automatically. Free to start. Available on Mac, iPhone, and iPad.

Its multimodal proprietary AI processes branded+Influencer+UGC video text, audio, Imagery into product-level metadata powering shopper agents, campaign agents, and insights agents. Vyrill powers in-video-"search, personalization, SEO/AEO, recommendations & Buy Now". Shoppers can instantly find “moments that matter” with clips+ summaries.

launches.name: Facts

launches.name: Tollecode

launches.name: Agentic API Grader by SaaStr.ai
launches.tagline: Your #1 new customer is an AI agent. Are they getting an A?
launches.description: API Report Card is a free tool from SaaStr.ai that grades any B2B API for how well it works in an agent-first world. It scores APIs across categories like authentication, error handling, documentation, pagination, idempotency, and overall agent-readiness, surfaces a letter grade from F to A+, and generates ready-to-paste prompts that developers can drop into Cursor, Claude, or Replit to fix the issues.

launches.name: TalentOS
launches.tagline: AI adoption operating system for companies
launches.description: TalentOS is the AI adoption operating system for companies. Drop in a business goal — like "cut support response time in half" — and TalentOS turns it into personalized AI projects for every employee, AI-grades the work against your rubrics, and gives managers a real-time dashboard of who can actually deliver. No courses. No certificates. Real projects, real graded output, real readiness scores.

launches.name: Editframe Launch

launches.description: Perf is an AI correction layer for teams shipping AI products. It sits between your app and your models, checks every output against your rules, and fixes or blocks issues before users see them. We’re opening a limited closed beta for teams dealing with hallucinations, incorrectly parsed JSON, policy violations, or unreliable AI responses.

launches.name: A/B

No more “let’s test and pray.” Now it’s test → predict → ship winners. Built for: • Performance marketers • DTC brands • Agencies • UGC teams • Growth teams • Founders running paid ads If creative is your growth bottleneck, this changes the game. Would love your feedback. And yes, we’re shipping fast.

launches.name: BlogSEO

launches.name: Fugubook

Plug in your Twilio webhook or a websocket endpoint powered by Pipecat, LiveKit, Vapi, or anything else. Got no voice agent? Build one on Fugubook in under a minute.

launches.name: CalUnity
launches.tagline: All your Google, Apple & Microsoft calendars in one free app
launches.description: Ever tried adding your Google Calendar into Apple Calendar? Events get jumbled, syncs break, edits don't propagate, most people give up and switch between apps every morning. CalUnity fixes this. Instead of cross-syncing, it connects directly to Google, Apple & Microsoft APIs and shows everything in one clean unified view. Your events stay where they belong. Works across iOS, Android & web. AI assistant finds free slots and detects conflicts. 100% free. No ads, no subscriptions.

launches.name: Mankinds
launches.tagline: Continuous AI testing, with audit ready proof
launches.description: We put your AI under real-world attack conditions: 80+ test criteria, 50+ attack techniques. Mapped to 70+ regulations across 5 regions covering EU AI Act, DORA, NIS2, SOC 2, ISO 42001 and a lot more. Continuous, from development all the way to live production.

launches.name: Disputron
launches.tagline: AI small claims court for petty disputes
launches.description: Settle your petty disputes with AI lawyers and an AI judge.

launches.name: TruLayer
launches.tagline: Tracing, evals, and a control loop for production LLMs
launches.description: TruLayer is an AI reliability platform for teams shipping LLMs to production. Tracing — OTLP-native plus SDKs for OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI, and 11 others. Evals — 25 LLM-judge evaluators inline: hallucination, faithfulness, tool-call correctness, PII, citation density. Control loop (new in v0.1) — eval fires → cluster → prompt diff → A/B → auto-ship → auto-rollback on regression. HITL gate at any step. Free tier: 1M spans/month, no card.

launches.name: Revamio
launches.tagline: Growth intelligence for the AI search era
launches.description: Revamio reads where your buyers now decide - ChatGPT, Perplexity, Reddit, competitor pricing pages, creator posts, competitor ads, and tells you what's happening, what matters, and what to ship first. Every signal comes with the content, reply, or action already drafted. Modern growth needs modern strategies!

launches.name: Kordis
launches.tagline: Generate a full Discord community from a single prompt.
launches.description: Setting up a professional Discord server used to be a nightmare. You either wasted 5+ hours manually configuring permissions, channel categories, and onboarding logic, or paid a freelancer $200+ to do it for you. Kordis kills this bottleneck. Type one prompt (e.g., "A hub for SaaS founders"), and our AI generates a complete, production-ready server in seconds: fully equipped with tailored channels, precise role permissions, and custom onboarding flows. Skip the setup, focus on community.

launches.name: ModelAlias
launches.tagline: Because a model change shouldn't become five redeploys.
launches.description: ModelAlias lets you create aliases for AI model names (like coding, support, or openai) and call them from your code. Point them to real models, then switch, upgrade or roll back from one dashboard. Every app using that alias instantly follows. No code changes. No redeploys. No scavenger hunts.

launches.name: CarCast
launches.tagline: ⭐ AI used-car price forecasts. See 60 days ahead.
launches.description: CarCast forecasts where used-car prices are heading 30 and 60 days out across 300+ vehicle segments. Each segment gets a Rising/Stable/Softening trend classification with P10/P50/P90 confidence bands. Free plan, weekly digest, dealer API on Pro.

launches.name: Strua
launches.tagline: Psychologist-built coping tools for stressful moments.
launches.description: Evidence-based mental health tools built by a licensed clinical psychologist. 23 tools free, 60+ on Pro. CBT, DBT, mindfulness techniques, and sleep protocols for the moments between therapy sessions. New in 1.1: a Sleep Suite, a Psychoeducational Library, and a Clinician Access Program. 90+ research citations. No chatbot, no streaks, no shame. Founding member pricing available.

launches.name: AIRankCite
launches.tagline: Track where AI mentions your SaaS across Reddit and forums
launches.description: AIRankCite helps solo founders and indie hackers track where AI mentions their product across Reddit, Hacker News, and forums. Find gaps and get actionable fixes.

launches.name: QuickBridge: AirDrop for Any Device
launches.tagline: Move files between your phone and PC instantly. No apps.
launches.description: QuickBridge lets you send files, text, and clipboard between your phone and computer instantly right in the browser. Just open → scan QR (or enter PIN) → transfer. Standout features: True peer-to-peer WebRTC (nothing stored on servers) Works perfectly across iPhone, Windows, Android Mac, Linux Persistent QR code (survives reloads) Smart reconnect + resume support SAS emoji safety codes (verify connection security) Direct-to-disk saving on Chrome No accounts. No installs. No server storage.

launches.name: Proved
launches.tagline: Auto-generate skill assessments when you post a job
launches.description: Proved scores every resume against your JD using AI. Candidates who qualify get an auto-generated assessment — they submit GitHub repo, live link and documentation. You see real proof of skills before the first interview.

launches.name: Aurra
launches.tagline: Memory for AI agents that ages gracefully
launches.description: The memory layer for AI agents. Persistent, source-cited, and honest about what it doesn't know. Install in 5 lines of Python.Most agent memory layers lose track of what changed. Aurra adds bi-temporal versioning to every memory: when it was true, when it stopped, what replaced it. Now with optional LLM auto-detection of supersession. Free tier, both Python and JS SDKs.

launches.name: SiteAgent MCP
launches.tagline: AI chatbot for any website — 3 lines of code, zero training
launches.description: SiteAgent MCP deploys an AI chatbot to any website in under 5 minutes. It auto-crawls your site content and answers visitor questions instantly — no manual training needed. Paste 3 lines of code into your tag. Works on WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, React, plain HTML. Free tier available. Powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash with Mistral fallback. Built on the MCP protocol — compatible with Claude Desktop and Cursor.

launches.name: Qenabler
launches.tagline: AI-powered quality enablement platform for engineering teams
launches.description: QEnabler is an AI-driven quality enablement platform built for engineering teams who want to shift quality left — before bugs reach production. Unlike traditional QA tools, QEnabler tracks quality maturity in one place. It turns quality from a bottleneck into a growth driver. Built by a QA engineering leader with 15+ years of experience, QEnabler gives teams actionable insights to move faster, ship confidently, and continuously improve.

launches.name: Velo 2.0
launches.tagline: Instantly turn your voice and screen into shareable videos
launches.description: Velo 2.0 is a whole new way to make video messages. It turns raw screen recordings into polished videos and docs, with a chat-native editor, real-time processing, voice cloning, and smart script rewriting. Edit by chatting, not timelines. Record once and get both a video and a doc. Write a script even when there is no audio. Change tone anytime. Everything updates live, so the whole experience feels faster, easier, and more natural.

launches.name: Ghostwriter
launches.tagline: Write and publish posts on LinkedIn & X
launches.description: Your personal AI ghostwriter that writes, schedules, and publishes posts on LinkedIn and X – so you never run out of content to share.

launches.name: Oriane
launches.tagline: The perception layer for Marketers and their AIs
launches.description: 91% of internet bandwidth is led by videos that your AI does NOT watch... Oriane watches millions of social videos a day, and turns what's on screen, in audio and in captions into a structured intelligence layer for teams and their AI apps to find niche creators, spot content trends, identify viral hooks and more!

launches.name: PaceBar
launches.tagline: A quiet pace instrument for your Mac
launches.description: PaceBar is a private Mac menu-bar app that turns on-device interaction patterns into a simple load readout, helping you notice rising work pace, reduce app switching, and take short resets when a session gets heavy.

launches.name: Dina
launches.tagline: From screen to polished video in minutes
launches.description: Dina is a macOS app that handles your entire video workflow in one place. Record your screen, edit clips, auto-clean audio, add voiceovers, transcript-driven editing, AI caption generation, text-to-speech voiceovers, keyboard shortcuts, beautiful annotations capabilities, ios recordings, upto 8k exports and many more — all without jumping between five different tools. Built for and creators who want professional results without the production nightmare.

launches.name: AWEAR
launches.tagline: Discreet brainwave wearable for real-time mental insights
launches.description: AWEAR is a discreet ear-worn EEG wearable that measures mental states in real time. While existing wearables track fitness, sleep, and nutrition, AWEAR directly captures brain activity to provide insights into stress, focus, and emotions. It is specifically designed to track brainwaves continuously unlike other neurotech devices. Our patent-pending AI translates brainwaves into actionable feedback through a mobile app, helping users understand and improve their mental wellbeing.

launches.name: Steam Controller
launches.tagline: Game with TMR sticks, dual haptic trackpads, + gyro controls
launches.description: Steam Controller is Valve’s new configurable controller for the full Steam library. It combines magnetic TMR thumbsticks, dual haptic trackpads, gyro, Grip Sense, four grip buttons, Steam Input customization, and a low-latency wireless charging puck.

launches.name: Breathwrk
launches.tagline: Learn and master breathwork with guided breathing exercises
launches.description: Breathwrk, now a part of Peloton, is #1 breathing app for Sleep, Stress, Focus, and Energy. Breathwrk is a simple yet powerful way to improve your mental and physical well-being in just seconds with neuroscience-based breathing exercises. Get a full sensory experience with customizable sounds, visuals, haptic vibrations, and breath coaches. Build your practice by setting reminders, tracking streaks, and following Breathwrk’s recommended protocols.

launches.name: Kodezi
launches.tagline: AI CTO for codebases
launches.description: Kodezi is the code reliability infrastructure for modern software. An autonomous operating system for codebases that acts as an AI CTO to maintain, heal, and evolve your system.

launches.name: Hutsy
launches.tagline: Stop guessing where your money goes — Hutsy tells you
launches.description: Hutsy gives consumers a daily money briefing that surfaces upcoming bills, likely fees, and next actions to stay on top of personal finances.

launches.name: PanicMode
launches.tagline: Protect your screen in public with one shortcut
launches.description: PanicMode is a native desktop app for macOS and Windows that lets you instantly cover your screen with a clean, neutral workspace using a single hotkey. Built for people working in public spaces, it helps avoid exposing emails, chats, or sensitive data when someone walks by. Choose from different workspace profiles (Developer, Office…) that blend naturally with your setup. No screenshots, no blur, just instant control.

launches.name: JustFixMe
launches.tagline: Select text. Press shortcut. Spelling fixed in place.
launches.description: Select any text in any app. Press one shortcut. JustFixMe rewrites it in place. No retyping, no distractions.

launches.name: SONODAY Radio
launches.tagline: Podcast radio: curated, continuous, and always on.
launches.description: SONODAY Radio brings back the magic of FM radio, but for podcasts. Instead of scrolling through endless feeds, choose a category (True Crime, Tech, Comedy, etc) and let it play. Curated shows stream continuously, 24/7, with real-time schedules so everyone hears the same episode at the same time. No algorithm. Just great podcasts playing like a radio station you never have to program. Rediscover a favorite or find something new! Free to listen. Premium unlocks skip, seek and custom stations.

launches.name: Spreaker Create | Free Podcast Editor
launches.tagline: Record, trim, adjust and export. Free, no login, no catch.
launches.description: Tired of paying $20/month for some basic audio editing? Spreaker Create is free, no installation and works directly in your browser. Record your voice, upload audio, layer background music, cut and move clips, adjust volume, and export a clean file. No downloads. No account. No paywall surprise. Your audio never leaves your device. 🎤 Record ⬆️ Upload ✂️ Cut & Adjust 🔊 Volume 🎵 Background music ⏪ Undo/redo 🔍 Zoom 💾 Export

launches.name: Violit
launches.tagline: Pure Python Web Framework: Streamlit simplicity, zero reruns
launches.description: I built Violit to liberate Python developers from the frontend. My goal is to eliminate the friction of turning complex backend logic or AI models into beautiful web apps. You shouldn't have to learn React or deal with sluggish full script reruns just to ship an idea. Violit combines an intuitive, 90% Streamlit-compatible syntax with instant signal-based reactivity and built-in themes. Build complete, production-ready web applications entirely in pure Python without the boilerplate.

launches.description: Calendars show your time. DustOff Reset shows your capacity. A real-time Human Bandwidth Index for knowledge workers, helping you plan deep work, meetings, admin, and resets around cognitive load, emotional residue, and contextual friction. Zen, Flow, and Legend modes respond to where you actually are. Built privacy-first with local processing. Not a timer. Not a wellness app. Capacity infrastructure for the AI work era, built for the human inside the system.

launches.name: GlobeIQ — Daily Geography Guessing Game
launches.tagline: Daily geography guessing game with a living world atlas
launches.description: GlobeIQ is a daily geography guessing game where you identify mystery countries from 6 progressive hints — continent, climate, borders, what it's known for, capital and flag. What makes it unique: every correct guess permanently lights up a real world map. Over time you build a glowing personal atlas of all 195 countries. Free to play. Works on mobile and desktop. Play at globeiq.app 🌍

launches.name: relly
launches.tagline: The AI teammate that ends follow-up meetings.
launches.description: Every meeting ends with "let's circle back next week." relly fixes that. It's a voice AI teammate that listens to your team's conversation and executes the work inside the meeting itself. Research, slides, drafts, decisions, all ready before you say goodbye. No more follow-ups.

launches.name: Cloe

Unlike legacy tools that require manual workflows, CLOE uses a deterministic accounting engine combined with AI to handle revenue recognition, reconciliations, and financial reporting end to end. It integrates directly with systems like Salesforce and NetSuite, understands contracts and policies, and produces audit-ready outputs without spreadsheets or consultants.

Scored quizzes, formal attestations, and exportable compliance reports via PDF or CSV. No sales calls, no seat minimums. $11.99/dev/year, all courses included. Built by a solo founder who got tired of $200/seat enterprise tools for training devs finish in an afternoon.
